title: Towards Conceptualization of “Fair Explanation”: Disparate Impacts of anti-Asian Hate Speech Explanations on Content Moderators

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting an online human-subject study simulating content moderation of anti-Asian hate speech to measure the disparate impacts of AI explanations (saliency maps vs. counterfactuals) on Asian versus non-Asian participants. The evaluation compares metrics such as mental discomfort (SPANE), stereotype activation, perceived workload (NASA-TLX), accuracy, and task time across the two racial groups.

Using Double Machine Learning and a Tree Interpreter to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects of AI explanation styles on stereotype activation across different age demographics (detailed in the appendix).

Using Double Machine Learning and a Tree Interpreter to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects of AI explanation styles on stereotype activation across different gender demographics, particularly noting interaction effects with age (e.g., elderly female participants).
